title: Amber memory interchange record (amber.v1)
description: One JSON object per line (JSONL). An open interchange format for agent memory: any tool may produce or consume it. Published so it can become a shared standard rather than a lock-in.

schema.description: Format identifier. Consumers must reject unknown schema strings.

id.description: Stable identifier within the exporting store.

content.description: The memory as a declarative statement.

trust.description: 0=user-stated, 1=user-approved, 2=auto-digest, 3=untrusted-origin. Importers MUST preserve tier. A T3 record marked active or aging is imported as quarantined; only review can activate it.

superseded_by.description: ID of the memory that replaced this one. Amber import remaps this reference if an ID collision occurs.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of normalized content (lowercased, punctuation stripped, whitespace collapsed). Import rejects a mismatch and uses the value for idempotence.
